note: docs/design/FLOOR.md Appendix B row 15's camera and capability-floor runs (card#7341) — AT-D3-21's floor half. Every run replays § 11's fixtures byte for byte — `fx-snapshot-4` through `fx-scene.json`'s `scene_default` and `scene_overflow` (the shipped default map, `@json:`), `fx-gap`'s resync pair, `fx-layout-acts`' `room.map`, `fx-drilldown`'s `fleet.health` and `fx-degraded`'s snapshot — at a viewport each run states (`floor.viewport`, CSS px) and with the viewer's camera acts on the scenario clock (`floor.camera`, `fleet-client-probe.mjs`'s header). F is § 12's viewport floor, and the test holds each run's stated viewport to the figure § 12 states.

camera_floor.note: AT-D3-21's floor half, the camera leg (Appendix B row 15): `fx-snapshot-4`'s four seats on the SHIPPED default map (`@json:`, the file itself) at a viewport of § 12's viewport floor, F. The viewer zooms with the wheel at a stated cursor point, drags by a stated offset, fits the floor, zooms in again three notches, drags, drags far past the floor's edge (the clamp), and drags once more — then the fleet sends a `seat.delta` (1000 ms), a `seat.delta` past a gap that resyncs the seat by fetch (2000 ms, `fx-gap`'s pair and its seat response), a `room.map` that re-fetches the room at version 4 (2500 ms, `fx-layout-acts`' message), and ends the stream (3000 ms), so the recovery reconnects and applies a second full snapshot. Every frame after the last camera act must carry the camera that act left. With the camera acts removed (an override of the page conditions) it is the discriminating control: the scene at fit and the log carrying exactly the messages' rows.
